item.title: Kwon Eunbi & Heo Yong Joon on the Long Game, Chapters Left Behind and the Beginning of Something Greater
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: Welcome to our special episode, part of Billboard's Global World Cup Series. The 2026 FIFA World Cup is just around the corner, and we're excited to pair top soccer stars with talented musicians from around the world. Today, we're shining the spotlight on South Korea, a team that's been on a remarkable streak since 1986.
[Upbeat K-pop music plays in the background]
Host: South Korea is heading to the World Cup for the 11th time in a row, and the nation is buzzing with excitement. The World Cup is more than just a tournament - it's an event that brings people together, with walkout anthems, stadium singalongs, and chants that unite tens of thousands of strangers.
[Music transitions to a more mellow tone]
Host: We're joined by two incredible talents from South Korea: singer Kwon Eunbi and footballer Heo Yong Joon. Kwon Eunbi has been making waves in the music scene, with her solo hits like "Underwater" and her new chapter with RBW. Heo Yong Joon, also known as "Heonaldo," has been chasing his goals in the K League and is now eyeing a move abroad.
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: We had the chance to sit down with Kwon Eunbi and talk about what it means to be part of this project. Kwon, how does it feel to bring music and sports together in this way?
[Kwon Eunbi's voice is played]
Kwon Eunbi: I think music and sports are deeply alike in the way they bring people's emotions together. The World Cup especially is such a special event - people all over the world cheering together in the same moment. It feels genuinely meaningful and exciting to be part of a project like this.
Host: That's amazing. Kwon, what does the World Cup bring back for you?
[Kwon Eunbi's voice is played again]
Kwon Eunbi: For me, the World Cup brings back memories of the whole family gathering in front of the TV to cheer together. When I was little, I remember watching the matches with my family in a Red Devils T-shirt - and I can still vividly picture the excitement and joy of those moments.
[Music transitions back to an upbeat tone]
Host: It's clear that the World Cup is more than just a tournament - it's a celebration of unity, passion, and excitement. We're thrilled to have Kwon Eunbi and Heo Yong Joon as part of our Global World Cup Series. Stay tuned for more episodes, and let's get ready to cheer on our favorite teams and artists!
[Energetic music continues to play until the end of the episode]
